On Valak Mountain, the Chilkin and Antol are[XENO:n ]
still at war. Help the Nopon[XENO:n ]
so they can conduct their survey safely.

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Poleaxe Chilkins[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Ent Antols[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.
Report to the survey team member.

After defeating the warring Chilkin and Antol,[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain is a little safer.

You've been asked to help the Research Team.[XENO:n ]
Go to areas of Valak Mountain with great views[XENO:n ]
and tell the team your impressions.

Admire the view from near Befalgar Pedestal[XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.

Admire the view from near Kaana Peak[XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.
Report to the survey team member.

You visited two peaks on Valak Mountain to[XENO:n ]
help the research.

You found a Nopon collapsed from the cold.[XENO:n ]
They seem to have some important information.[XENO:n ]
Find something warm to help them.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Hogs Flints[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Porcu Hogs on Valak Mountain.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Antol Fire Pouches[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Ent Antols on Valak Mountain.

Obtain 1 portion of [System:Color name=item ]Feris Aged Spirits[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from a Noto Feris on Valak Mountain.
Return to the collapsed Nopon.

The Nopon warmed up and made a full recovery.[XENO:n ]
They returned to the survey team with their information.

You freed a Nopon held captive by the Chilkin.[XENO:n ]
Unfortunately, the guards were due to arrive.[XENO:n ]
Scatter the Chilkin and escape!

Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Vicious Chilkins[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.
Report to the freed Nopon.

You rescued the captive Nopon.[XENO:n ]
They returned to the team with remarkable information.

Top-secret information says the Chilkin leader is away.[XENO:n ]
Take this chance to investigate Chilkin Lair.

Investigate Chilkin Lair near Bagnar Snowfield[XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.
Return to Daruku.

The investigation revealed that Chilkin Lair[XENO:n ]
had been occupied by the Antol.

You need to defeat the Chilkin and Antol leaders[XENO:n ]
to maintain the ecological balance of Valak Mountain.

At Antol Den on Valak Mountain,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Barbaric Sitri[/System:Color].

Somewhere on Valak Mountain,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Banquet Vassago[/System:Color].
Return to Daruku.

You ended the conflict between the Chilkin and Antol[XENO:n ]
and maintained Valak Mountain's ecological balance.

To break the deadlock, Zain apparently went[XENO:n ]
to the dangerous summit alone.[XENO:n ]
Head to Valak Mountain's summit and help him!

Talk to Zain near 3 Great Sages' Summit[XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.
Return to Krall.

You safely rescued Zain, who went to the summit alone.[XENO:n ]
He said something interesting when he asked for help[XENO:line ]

Gather the Giants' treasures scattered around the world[XENO:n ]
and break the seal on the ruins at 3 Great Sages' Summit.

Collect 3 Giants' treasures[XENO:n ]
from around the world.

Go to the Giants' ruins at 3 Great Sages' Summit[XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.

The door to the ruins on 3 Great Sages' Summit[XENO:n ]
is open. Inside a great power rests.

Gather the Giants' treasures scattered around the world.[XENO:n ]
You don't know where they are or who has them.[XENO:n ]
But someone researching them might know[XENO:line ]
Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Giants' Wisdom[/System:Color].
Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Giants' Courage[/System:Color].
Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Heart of the Giants[/System:Color].

All three Giants' treasures have been gathered.[XENO:n ]
The seal on the ruins at 3 Great Sages' Summit may open.

Thick ice covered the door to the tower Alviss mentioned.[XENO:n ]
Magma Rock can be found in a cave near the geyser[XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain. Perhaps it can melt the ice.
Obtain [System:Color name=item ]Magma Rock[/System:Color] in the cave near the geyser.
Use [System:Color name=item ]Magma Rock[/System:Color] to melt the ice covering the door.
